## Checklist (Definition of Done)

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is an automated test and passes
- [ ] Cross-tenant tests cover new routes, jobs, files or exports
- [ ] Server-side authorization and audit events for every new mutating action
- [ ] Migrations upgrade and downgrade cleanly
- [ ] OpenAPI and generated client updated
- [ ] Arabic and English strings; RTL checked for new screens
- [ ] Errors are actionable; empty and loading states exist
- [ ] Docs updated (data dictionary, ADR, runbook, formulation)
- [ ] No secrets or personal data anywhere in the diff
